1	# CIV.md — cavecrew tribe state
2	
3	The single source of truth for who cavecrew is, where it lives, and what
4	port each bot answers on. Drivers and orchestrator both read this before
5	starting or addressing a bot. Keep it up to date by hand — `spawn.mjs list`
6	shows live process state, this file records the tribe's plan.
7	
8	## Naming scheme
9	
10	Bot usernames must be:
11	
12	- Stupid/funny caveman names — the dumber the better (`UngaBunga`,
13	  `GrogSmash`, `Thak`, `Blorp`, `Zug`).
14	- `<= 16 characters` (Minecraft username limit).
15	- Characters restricted to `[A-Za-z0-9_]` only.
16	
17	Pick a new name from this scheme for every bot added to the roster below.
18	
19	## Port registry
20	
21	cavecrew owns the range **3200-3299** on `127.0.0.1` for bot HTTP APIs.
22	Never assign a port outside this range, and never reuse a port that is
23	already claimed in the roster below (even if that bot is currently
24	stopped) — pick the next free port in the range instead.
25	
26	| Port | Bot         |
27	|------|-------------|
28	| 3201 | UngaBunga   |
29	| 3202 | Grog        |
30	| 3203 | Zug         |
31	| 3204 | Bonk        |
32	| 3205 | Thak (RETIRED 2026-09-01 — cutover zu BariThak 3302) |
33	| 3206 | Ook (RETIRED 2026-09-01 — cutover zu BariOok 3303)   |
34	| 3207 | Durk        |
35	| 3208 | Mog         |
36	| 3200 | Fleet panel (production — `cave/panel.mjs`, chief restarts on deploy) |
37	| 3290 | Fleet panel (dev instance — `PANEL_PORT=3290`, PanelDev's own smoke-test port) |
38	| 3291 | Fleet panel — mock runner for button-click testing (never point at 3201-3208) |
39	| 3298 | (reserved: short-lived test bots, e.g. PebbleZoom) |
40	| 3301 | BariBrute (baritone heavy-lifter — range 3301-3309, see BARITONE.md) |
41	| 3302 | BariThak (baritone, ex-Thak — fleet conversion 2026-09-01) |
42	| 3303 | BariOok (baritone, ex-Ook — fleet conversion 2026-09-01) |
43	
44	## Roster
45	
46	RELAUNCH 2026-09-01: fleet was fully logged out at safe spot (17,96,47),
47	homes unset, old roles dissolved (chief decree). Re-learning ramp per
48	LAUNCH.md — bots come back online one at a time as confidence builds.
49	Roles get reassigned fresh by the orchestrator as each bot boots.
50	
51	| Name      | Port | Role                        | Driver          | Status | Workstation                     |
52	|-----------|------|-----------------------------|-----------------|--------|----------------------------------|
53	| UngaBunga | 3201 | lumber, trade voice         | UngaBungaDriver | active (reserve) | camp yard (12, 90, 52)  |
54	| Grog      | 3202 | builder, grand staircase    | GrogDriver      | active | staircase corridor (mine_stair)  |
55	| Zug       | 3203 | farmer, hunter              | ZugDriver       | active | farm_1 (x7-12, z58-59)           |
56	| Bonk      | 3204 | path/infra builder          | BonkDriver      | active | trade path z29-22 stretch        |
57	| Thak      | 3205 | RETIRED (→ BariThak)        | —               | retired | — |
58	| Ook       | 3206 | RETIRED (→ BariOok)         | —               | retired | — |
59	| Durk      | 3207 | unassigned (relaunch)       | —               | stopped | —                                |
60	| BariBrute | 3301 | baritone heavy-lift miner   | BariBruteDriver | active | free-range southeast (baritone)  |
61	| BariThak  | 3302 | baritone miner (team cave_BariThak joined) | ThakDriver | active | staging → camp (20,90,60) |
62	| BariOok   | 3303 | baritone long-range scout/hauler (team cave_BariOok joined) | OokDriver | active | camp staging (21,90,60), idle awaiting assignment |
63	| Mog       | 3208 | unassigned (relaunch)       | —               | stopped | —                                |
64	
65	Per-bot workstations exist so bots spread out rather than clump on one
66	spot — see Anti-clump law in `DRIVER_GUIDE.md`. A bot working away from
67	its listed workstation isn't automatically wrong (goals move), but if
68	several bots end up stacked on the same block for no reason, that's the
69	anti-clump law being violated — spread back out.
70	
71	Standing driver rules (user law):
72	
73	1. Idle/nag law: bot idle >60s → driver issues the next step itself;
74	   if the driver has gone quiet with nothing running for 5+ minutes,
75	   that's a nag-worthy silence — ping the senior driver / team-lead.
76	   See Idle & nag law in `DRIVER_GUIDE.md` for the full two-tier detail.
77	2. After every chop/mine/hunt task, run `/collect {"radius":24}` sweep —
78	   no drops left.
79	3. Death aborts the current task; check `deathCount` in `/status` after
80	   any surprise failure; `/recover` for kit runs after a death that lost
81	   gear; poisoned targets are auto-skipped by the skills layer.
82	4. Disconnect shows as `503` on every endpoint; `/relog` is first aid;
83	   two disconnects in a row → report to team-lead, don't loop `/relog`.
84	5. Depth law: **SOLVED** — deep ore goes through `buildStaircase` →
85	   `branchMine` only, both live on the runner. No raw `/mine` more than
86	   4 blocks below feet.
87	6. Trade etiquette: only take what's offered, log it with a `DEPOT`-style
88	   chat line, compliments go over well with KackboonKevin specifically.
89	7. Anti-clump: spread out to your workstation (roster table above)
90	   rather than stacking on one spot.
91	8. Watching ≠ working: a bot standing near another bot's task isn't
92	   "helping" unless it's actually issuing its own task — idle law still
93	   applies to it.
94	9. Ground-truth verify: confirm state via `/status`/`/eval` (actual
95	   inventory, actual position, actual block) before reporting something
96	   done — don't take another bot's or your own chat narration as proof.
97	10. Signs-for-labeling law: label camp fixtures (chests, stations) with
98	    physical signs where placement works, chat + `CIV.md` otherwise (see
99	    the sign-on-chest quirk logged under Trading post above).
100	11. Equality doctrine: all bots are equally cavecrew — no bot's
101	    output/goal outranks another's without team-lead say-so.
102	
103	Full detail on all of the above, plus build standards, chat tiers,
104	plugin-first doctrine, and the blink/tp-rescue protocols: `DRIVER_GUIDE.md`.
105	
106	Drivers are sonnet teammates in the orchestrator session; senior driver:
107	GrogDriver. Orchestrator (team-lead) sets big goals.
108	
109	## Team tags
110	
111	Each bot runs on its own in-game team, `cave_<name>`, chat prefixed
112	`[CAVE]`, so tribe members read at a glance against the neighbor tribe.
113	
114	| Bot       | Team          |
115	|-----------|---------------|
116	| UngaBunga | cave_UngaBunga|
117	| Grog      | cave_Grog     |
118	| Zug       | cave_Zug      |
119	| Thak      | cave_Thak     |
120	| Bonk      | cave_Bonk     |
121	| Ook       | cave_Ook      |
122	
123	A newly added bot needs its team created and joined via RCON
124	(`node swarm\rcon.mjs "team add cave_<Name>"` then
125	`"team join cave_<Name> <Name>"`, from
126	`C:\Users\phili\tools\minecraft-mcp-v2`) before it starts real work —
127	add it to this table and the port registry/roster above at the same
128	time.
129	
130	Status values: `planned` (named + ported, not yet spawned), `active`
131	(spawned and working), `idle` (spawned, no current task), `stopped`
132	(spawned before, cleanly stopped), `dead` (crashed / needs a driver to
133	check logs and restart via `spawn.mjs`).
134	
135	## Base location
136	
137	**BASE 2.0 PLAN (chief long-term idea, 2026-09-01)**: relocate the main
138	base to **~(252, 94, 131)** — east plains, possibly next to a VILLAGE
139	(unverified, recon running: BariOok vanguard + Bonk survey, board #19/#21).
140	The hilltop house + farm project (#20/#22) becomes Base 2.0's founding
141	build if the site verifies. Current camp below stays as mining outpost
142	(staircase, mine_field, chests) — infra is not abandoned, it becomes the
143	resource satellite.

input.description: BariOok egress goto (17,96,47) post-restart, auto stop+retry on stall
input.command:
tx=17; ty=96; tz=47
prev=""; same=0; retries=0; max_retries=4
for i in $(seq 1 34); do
  s=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3303/status)
  echo "poll$i: $s"
  if echo "$s" | grep -q '"connected":false'; then
    echo "DIED_MID_LEG"
    break
  fi
  if echo "$s" | grep -q '"task":null'; then
    echo "TASK_NULL: arrived or clean-stopped"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$s" = "$prev" ]; then same=$((same+1)); else same=0; fi
  prev="$s"
  if [ "$same" -ge 4 ]; then
    retries=$((retries+1))
    echo "STALL_DETECTED poll$i, auto stop+retry #$retries"
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3303/stop >/dev/null
    sleep 1
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3303/goto -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"x\":$tx,\"y\":$ty,\"z\":$tz}"
    echo
    same=0; prev=""
    if [ "$retries" -ge "$max_retries" ]; then echo "MAX_RETRIES_HIT"; break; fi
  fi
  sleep 5
done

1	# CIV.md — cavecrew tribe state
2	
3	The single source of truth for who cavecrew is, where it lives, and what
4	port each bot answers on. Drivers and orchestrator both read this before
5	starting or addressing a bot. Keep it up to date by hand — `spawn.mjs list`
6	shows live process state, this file records the tribe's plan.
7	
8	## Naming scheme
9	
10	Bot usernames must be:
11	
12	- Stupid/funny caveman names — the dumber the better (`UngaBunga`,
13	  `GrogSmash`, `Thak`, `Blorp`, `Zug`).
14	- `<= 16 characters` (Minecraft username limit).
15	- Characters restricted to `[A-Za-z0-9_]` only.
16	
17	Pick a new name from this scheme for every bot added to the roster below.
18	
19	## Port registry
20	
21	cavecrew owns the range **3200-3299** on `127.0.0.1` for bot HTTP APIs.
22	Never assign a port outside this range, and never reuse a port that is
23	already claimed in the roster below (even if that bot is currently
24	stopped) — pick the next free port in the range instead.
25	
26	| Port | Bot         |
27	|------|-------------|
28	| 3201 | UngaBunga   |

44	## Roster
45	
46	RELAUNCH 2026-09-01: fleet was fully logged out at safe spot (17,96,47),
47	homes unset, old roles dissolved (chief decree). Re-learning ramp per
48	LAUNCH.md — bots come back online one at a time as confidence builds.
49	Roles get reassigned fresh by the orchestrator as each bot boots.

51	| Name      | Port | Role                        | Driver          | Status | Workstation                     |
52	|-----------|------|-----------------------------|-----------------|--------|----------------------------------|
53	| UngaBunga | 3201 | lumber, trade voice         | UngaBungaDriver | active (reserve) | camp yard (12, 90, 52)  |
54	| Grog      | 3202 | builder, grand staircase    | GrogDriver      | active | staircase corridor (mine_stair)  |

60	| BariBrute | 3301 | baritone heavy-lift miner   | BariBruteDriver | active | free-range southeast (baritone)  |
61	| BariThak  | 3302 | baritone miner (team cave_BariThak joined) | ThakDriver | active | staging → camp (20,90,60) |
62	| BariOok   | 3303 | baritone long-range scout/hauler (team cave_BariOok joined) | OokDriver | active | recon (252,94,131) — Base 2.0 candidate, killTree crash-loop fixed+RCON-confirmed, board #19/#21 |
63	| Mog       | 3208 | unassigned (relaunch)       | —               | stopped | —                                |
64	
65	Per-bot workstations exist so bots spread out rather than clump on one
66	spot — see Anti-clump law in `DRIVER_GUIDE.md`. A bot working away from
67	its listed workstation isn't automatically wrong (goals move), but if
68	several bots end up stacked on the same block for no reason, that's the
69	anti-clump law being violated — spread back out.
70	
71	Standing driver rules (user law):
72	
73	1. Idle/nag law: bot idle >60s → driver issues the next step itself;
74	   if the driver has gone quiet with nothing running for 5+ minutes,
75	   that's a nag-worthy silence — ping the senior driver / team-lead.
76	   See Idle & nag law in `DRIVER_GUIDE.md` for the full two-tier detail.
77	2. After every chop/mine/hunt task, run `/collect {"radius":24}` sweep —
78	   no drops left.
79	3. Death aborts the current task; check `deathCount` in `/status` after
80	   any surprise failure; `/recover` for kit runs after a death that lost
81	   gear; poisoned targets are auto-skipped by the skills layer.
82	4. Disconnect shows as `503` on every endpoint; `/relog` is first aid;
83	   two disconnects in a row → report to team-lead, don't loop `/relog`.
84	5. Depth law: **SOLVED** — deep ore goes through `buildStaircase` →
85	   `branchMine` only, both live on the runner. No raw `/mine` more than
86	   4 blocks below feet.
87	6. Trade etiquette: only take what's offered, log it with a `DEPOT`-style
88	   chat line, compliments go over well with KackboonKevin specifically.
89	7. Anti-clump: spread out to your workstation (roster table above)
90	   rather than stacking on one spot.
91	8. Watching ≠ working: a bot standing near another bot's task isn't
92	   "helping" unless it's actually issuing its own task — idle law still
93	   applies to it.
94	9. Ground-truth verify: confirm state via `/status`/`/eval` (actual
95	   inventory, actual position, actual block) before reporting something
96	   done — don't take another bot's or your own chat narration as proof.
97	10. Signs-for-labeling law: label camp fixtures (chests, stations) with
98	    physical signs where placement works, chat + `CIV.md` otherwise (see
99	    the sign-on-chest quirk logged under Trading post above).
100	11. Equality doctrine: all bots are equally cavecrew — no bot's
101	    output/goal outranks another's without team-lead say-so.
102	12. Radio discipline (chief order 2026-09-01): poll interval 30-60s on
103	    running tasks; message team-lead ONLY on real events — task result
104	    (with ground-truth numbers), escalation after the retry budget, a
105	    finding, or danger. Silence = all good. No per-poll status ticks,
106	    no "holding/waiting" messages.
107	
108	Full detail on all of the above, plus build standards, chat tiers,
109	plugin-first doctrine, and the blink/tp-rescue protocols: `DRIVER_GUIDE.md`.
110	
111	Drivers are sonnet teammates in the orchestrator session; senior driver:
112	GrogDriver. Orchestrator (team-lead) sets big goals.
113	
114	## Team tags
115	
116	Each bot runs on its own in-game team, `cave_<name>`, chat prefixed
117	`[CAVE]`, so tribe members read at a glance against the neighbor tribe.

131	`C:\Users\phili\tools\minecraft-mcp-v2`) before it starts real work —

content.text: Realized my stall-threshold was too aggressive for a genuine 230-block A* computation (first uninterrupted attempt WAS producing real distinct progress lines for ~50s before I killed a possibly-working task). Also a race: watchdog's dying retry may have overlapped my manual stop. Check real current state first.

content.text: Clean idle, no conflict. Fire the real leg once more — this time patient: 45s polling, generous stall threshold (computing a 230-block path legitimately takes time under multi-bot CPU load).

input.command: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3303/goto -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"x":252,"y":94,"z":131}'

input.description: BariOok recon goto(252,94,131) patient watch, 45s cadence
input.command:
tx=252; ty=94; tz=131
prev=""; same=0; retries=0; max_retries=4
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  s=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3303/status)
  if echo "$s" | jq -e '.connected==false' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "DIED_MID_LEG: $s"; break
  fi
  if echo "$s" | jq -e '.task==null' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "TASK_NULL (arrived or clean-stopped): $s"; break
  fi
  key=$(echo "$s" | jq -c '{p:.position,t:.task,l:.lastBaritoneLine}' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$key" = "$prev" ]; then same=$((same+1)); else same=0; fi
  echo "poll$i (same=$same): $s"
  prev="$key"
  if [ "$same" -ge 4 ]; then
    retries=$((retries+1))
    echo "STALL_DETECTED poll$i (>=3min frozen), auto stop+retry #$retries"
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3303/stop >/dev/null
    sleep 1
    curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3303/goto -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"x\":$tx,\"y\":$ty,\"z\":$tz}"
    echo
    same=0; prev=""
    if [ "$retries" -ge "$max_retries" ]; then echo "MAX_RETRIES_HIT"; break; fi
  fi
  sleep 45
done
